description: This is a front-end component file for a shopping application's header, built using Lightning.js components. It defines a header that displays the shopping cart item count and total price with themed styling.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that renders the header section of the shopping app, including cart item count and total price.

methods.name: itemsLabel
methods.description: Computes and returns a string representing the number of items in the cart.

methods.name: totalLabel
methods.description: Computes and returns a formatted string of the total price.
